limitations: Positive/negative labels mean the supplied accepted target reference, never guilt, innocence, SAR filing or criminal truth.
Counts are observed evidence and precision/recall describe only the exact labeled sample; no probability inference is implemented.
Alert volume, review speed and unit cost are operational observations, not detection effectiveness.
Benchmarks are contextual references and are not pooled with engine observations or used as institutional thresholds.
Supplied source/fact/profile and reviewer identities are not authenticated.
Exact value mappings establish consistency, not truth or substantive legal sufficiency.
Professional applicability, acceptance and operational authority remain human-owned.
